phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe system integrating a capacitive sensing probe, a microcontroller unit (MCU) for signal processing, and a low-power radio transceiver for wireless data transmission, designed for precision agricultural soil moisture monitoring.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The capacitive soil moisture sensor probe is the industry standard for soil moisture measurement due to its improved durability and accuracy over resistive sensors. Integration with an MCU and radio for wireless telemetry is now common in modern agricultural IoT devices, enabling remote and real-time moisture data collection essential in precision agriculture.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and a radio frequency communication module, designed for non-invasive soil moisture measurement and wireless data transmission in agricultural settings.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This configuration is the industry standard for modern precision agriculture sensing, combining capacitive soil moisture measurement technology with embedded processing and wireless telemetry to enable real-time remote monitoring, widely adopted in commercial and research agriculture due to reliability, low power use, and ease of deployment.
